the trim-coil power supply system has been improved to the point where the set points for an experiment are automatically realized and maintained with a precision that is adequate for the experiments.
the system reduces trim-coils setup time to less that 5 min, that it maintains set points within 4% over an 8-h period and that it is being extended to control other machine-parameters.
the trim-coil power-supply control system is a success.

developing the automatic control of the cyclotron for the efficient and reliable operation of this machine in the future.
the development of an automatic-control system for an accelerator.
the automatic control of a large-scale, high-energy physics experiment.

the automatic-control system for the 88-inch trim-coil power supply has been successful in its operation and has provided the cyclotron staff with a reliable and accurate means of operating the trim coils.

the system has proven to be a valuable addition to the operation of the Berkeley 88-inch cycloteron.

the automatic-control system has made the 88-inch machine a much more useful research tool.
